project.name: TARAflow Example – Simple Controller – 01 Goals derived

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::D.attackDescription: Attacker applies excessive electrical input or flooding signals to the interface causing it to fail
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::D.causeDescription: Interface has no protection against electrical stress or signal flooding — it can be disabled by physical or signal attack
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::D.threatDescription: Interface denial of service — attacker renders the interface unavailable

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::E.attackDescription: Attacker exploits the interface to run privileged commands and bypass access controls, or uploads unsigned malicious firmware that disables security controls or installs a persistent backdoor
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::E.causeDescription: Interface exposes privileged functions without sufficient authentication and accepts firmware updates without signature verification
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::E.threatDescription: Interface privilege escalation — attacker uses the interface to gain elevated access or inject unauthorized firmware

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::I.attackDescription: Attacker attaches monitoring equipment to the physical interface and captures transmitted data
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::I.causeDescription: Physical interface transmits data without encryption — signals are readable with basic test equipment
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::I.threatDescription: Interface eavesdropping — attacker intercepts data on the physical interface

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::R.attackDescription: Attacker connects to the physical interface and denies having accessed it because no log record exists
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::R.causeDescription: No logging of physical interface connections — who connected and when is unknown
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::R.threatDescription: Interface access repudiation — physical interface access cannot be attributed

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::S.attackDescription: Attacker connects a rogue device to the interface and impersonates a legitimate system, gaining unauthorized access
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::S.causeDescription: No hardware authentication on the interface — any device connecting is trusted without verification
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::S.threatDescription: Interface identity spoofing — attacker impersonates a legitimate device on the interface

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::T.attackDescription: Attacker modifies the interface hardware or firmware to intercept, inject, or block communications
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::T.causeDescription: Interface lacks tamper detection and physical protection — unauthorized modification is possible without detection
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-10::T.threatDescription: Interface tampering — attacker physically or logically tampers with the interface

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-12::D.attackDescription: Attacker sends high volume of requests consuming all available CPU, memory, or file handles
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-12::D.causeDescription: No resource limits or rate limiting — process allocates unbounded resources in response to requests
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-12::D.threatDescription: Process resource exhaustion — attacker exhausts process resources causing denial of service

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-12::T.attackDescription: Attacker disrupts communication; without a defined fail-safe state, outputs may drive actuators dangerously
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-12::T.causeDescription: No deterministic fail-safe output state defined — actuator outputs are unpredictable under fault
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-12::T.threatDescription: Undefined fail-safe output state — process outputs reach arbitrary values on communication loss

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::D.attackDescription: Attacker blocks or corrupts the data flow causing dependent components to lose communication
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::D.causeDescription: No redundancy or timeout protection — disruption causes loss of communication
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::D.threatDescription: Data flow disruption — attacker blocks or delays the data flow

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::I.attackDescription: Attacker passively monitors the data flow and captures sensitive data
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::I.causeDescription: Data flow is unencrypted — sensitive payload is transmitted in plaintext
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::I.threatDescription: Data flow eavesdropping — attacker intercepts sensitive data on the data flow

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::T.attackDescription: Attacker attaches a hardware probe to the embedded bus and injects or modifies transmitted data
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::T.causeDescription: Embedded bus communication carries no integrity protection or authentication
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::T.threatDescription: Embedded bus data tampering — attacker modifies communication on internal bus

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::D.attackDescription: Attacker sends high volume of requests consuming all available CPU, memory, or file handles
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::D.causeDescription: No resource limits or rate limiting — process allocates unbounded resources in response to requests
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::D.threatDescription: Process resource exhaustion — attacker exhausts process resources causing denial of service

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::E.attackDescription: Attacker exploits a process vulnerability to execute code or trigger operations with elevated privileges
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::E.causeDescription: Insufficient input validation or privilege boundary enforcement in the process
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::E.threatDescription: Privilege escalation via process vulnerability — attacker gains elevated privileges through process flaw

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::I.attackDescription: Attacker observes process output and extracts sensitive configuration data, credentials, or business information
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::I.causeDescription: Process outputs or error messages contain sensitive information — no output filtering applied
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::I.threatDescription: Process data leakage — sensitive data processed by the process is exposed

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::R.attackDescription: Process or its operator denies having executed a command that affected the system
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::R.causeDescription: Audit log is absent, incomplete, or not tamper-proof
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::R.threatDescription: Process action repudiation — process denies having performed an action

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::S.attackDescription: Attacker injects requests pretending to be a legitimate caller
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::S.causeDescription: Insufficient process authentication — callers are not required to prove their identity
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::S.threatDescription: Process identity spoofing — attacker impersonates a legitimate process

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::T.attackDescription: Attacker disrupts communication; without a defined fail-safe state, outputs may drive actuators dangerously
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::T.causeDescription: No deterministic fail-safe output state defined — actuator outputs are unpredictable under fault
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-16::T.threatDescription: Undefined fail-safe output state — process outputs reach arbitrary values on communication loss

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-18::D.attackDescription: Attacker fills the data store to capacity or corrupts its index causing all operations to fail
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-18::D.causeDescription: No redundancy for data store access — single point of failure
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-18::D.threatDescription: Data store unavailability — attacker makes the data store inaccessible

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-18::I.attackDescription: Attacker reads non-volatile memory to extract firmware, cryptographic keys, or sensitive configuration
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-18::I.causeDescription: Flash/EEPROM/NVRAM lacks readback protection — stored keys and credentials are readable
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-18::I.threatDescription: Embedded storage information disclosure — attacker reads sensitive data from non-volatile memory

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-18::T.attackDescription: Attacker uses debug interface to modify firmware, configuration, or calibration data
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-18::T.causeDescription: Flash/EEPROM/NVRAM storage lacks access control or integrity protection
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-18::T.threatDescription: Embedded storage tampering — attacker modifies data in non-volatile memory

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::D.attackDescription: Attacker physically damages the device or cuts power, causing immediate loss of availability
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::D.causeDescription: No physical protection or anchoring — device can be damaged, unplugged, or destroyed
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::D.threatDescription: Physical destruction or power disruption — device rendered unavailable by physical attack

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::E.attackDescription: Attacker opens the physical boundary and connects to internal debug interface, bypassing all software authentication
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::E.causeDescription: Physical access to device interior grants debug/hardware access — logical security can be bypassed
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::E.threatDescription: Physical privilege escalation — attacker gains elevated system access via physical boundary breach

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::I.attackDescription: Attacker measures power consumption or EM emissions and extracts cryptographic keys
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::I.causeDescription: Physical boundary provides no electromagnetic shielding — internal operations are observable
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::I.threatDescription: Side-channel observation — sensitive data extracted via physical measurements

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::T.attackDescription: Attacker opens the enclosure without triggering any alarm, gaining access to internal components
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::T.causeDescription: No tamper detection mechanism — unauthorized opening is undetected
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-1::T.threatDescription: Physical boundary tampering — unauthorized physical access to boundary interior

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::D.attackDescription: Attacker blocks or corrupts the data flow causing dependent components to lose communication
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::D.causeDescription: No redundancy or timeout protection — disruption causes loss of communication
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::D.threatDescription: Data flow disruption — attacker blocks or delays the data flow

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::I.attackDescription: Attacker passively monitors the data flow and captures sensitive data
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::I.causeDescription: Data flow is unencrypted — sensitive payload is transmitted in plaintext
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::I.threatDescription: Data flow eavesdropping — attacker intercepts sensitive data on the data flow

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::T.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts and modifies values before they reach the destination
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::T.causeDescription: Data flow is unprotected — no integrity check or encryption prevents modification
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::T.threatDescription: Data flow tampering — attacker modifies data in transit between components

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::D.attackDescription: Attacker blocks or corrupts the data flow causing dependent components to lose communication
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::D.causeDescription: No redundancy or timeout protection — disruption causes loss of communication
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::D.threatDescription: Data flow disruption — attacker blocks or delays the data flow

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::I.attackDescription: Attacker passively monitors the data flow and captures sensitive data
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::I.causeDescription: Data flow is unencrypted — sensitive payload is transmitted in plaintext
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::I.threatDescription: Data flow eavesdropping — attacker intercepts sensitive data on the data flow

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::T.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts and modifies values before they reach the destination
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::T.causeDescription: Data flow is unprotected — no integrity check or encryption prevents modification
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::T.threatDescription: Data flow tampering — attacker modifies data in transit between components

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::I.attackDescription: Attacker passively monitors the data flow and captures sensitive data
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::I.causeDescription: Data flow is unencrypted — sensitive payload is transmitted in plaintext
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::I.threatDescription: Data flow eavesdropping — attacker intercepts sensitive data on the data flow

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::T.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts and modifies values before they reach the destination
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::T.causeDescription: Data flow is unprotected — no integrity check or encryption prevents modification
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::T.threatDescription: Data flow tampering — attacker modifies data in transit between components

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-5::R.attackDescription: External entity denies having sent a command that the system received and acted upon
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-5::R.causeDescription: No non-repudiation mechanism — requests from external entities are not cryptographically bound to the sender
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-5::R.threatDescription: External entity repudiation — external entity denies having sent a request

Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-5::S.attackDescription: Attacker crafts requests that appear to originate from a legitimate external entity
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-5::S.causeDescription: No authentication mechanism enforced for external entities
Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-5::S.threatDescription: External entity identity spoofing — attacker impersonates a legitimate external entity

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::D::incoming.attackDescription: Attacker sends a high volume of requests via the data flow, exhausting the processing capacity of Controller
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::D::incoming.causeDescription: No rate limiting or request throttling protecting Controller from high-volume input via Operator
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::D::incoming.threatDescription: Request flooding: Attacker overwhelms Controller with excessive incoming requests

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::D::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker disrupts or delays the response channel from Controller, causing Operator to stall or fail
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::D::outgoing.causeDescription: No redundancy or timeout protection — Operator depends on responses from Controller to continue operation
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::D::outgoing.threatDescription: Response blocking: Attacker prevents Operator from receiving responses from Controller

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::I::incoming.attackDescription: Attacker attaches a logic analyzer to the embedded bus and captures all traffic
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::I::incoming.causeDescription: Embedded bus communication is unencrypted and physically accessible — data can be passively captured
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::I::incoming.threatDescription: Eavesdropping on embedded bus DF-1 between Operator and Controller

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::I::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts the response from Controller to Operator and reads sensitive information
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::I::outgoing.causeDescription: Unencrypted or weakly protected response channel — response data is readable in transit
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::I::outgoing.threatDescription: Eavesdropping on response: Attacker intercepts sensitive response data from Controller

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::T::incoming.attackDescription: Attacker attaches a hardware probe to the embedded bus and injects or modifies data packets
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::T::incoming.causeDescription: Embedded bus carries no integrity protection or authentication — data is transmitted in plaintext
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::T::incoming.threatDescription: Data tampering on embedded bus DF-1 between Operator and Controller

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::T::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts the response from Controller and modifies data, causing Operator to process falsified information
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::T::outgoing.causeDescription: Missing integrity protection on the response flow from Controller — Operator cannot detect modified responses
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-14::T::outgoing.threatDescription: Response tampering: Attacker modifies response data before it reaches Operator

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::D::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker disrupts or delays the response channel from Controller, causing Config Store to stall or fail
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::D::outgoing.causeDescription: No redundancy or timeout protection — Config Store depends on responses from Controller to continue operation
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::D::outgoing.threatDescription: Response blocking: Attacker prevents Config Store from receiving responses from Controller

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::I::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts the response from Controller to Config Store and reads sensitive information
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::I::outgoing.causeDescription: Unencrypted or weakly protected response channel — response data is readable in transit
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::I::outgoing.threatDescription: Eavesdropping on response: Attacker intercepts sensitive response data from Controller

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::T::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts the response from Controller and modifies data, causing Config Store to process falsified information
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::T::outgoing.causeDescription: Missing integrity protection on the response flow from Controller — Config Store cannot detect modified responses
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-20::T::outgoing.threatDescription: Response tampering: Attacker modifies response data before it reaches Config Store

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::D::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker disrupts or delays the response channel from Config Store, causing Controller to stall or fail
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::D::outgoing.causeDescription: No redundancy or timeout protection — Controller depends on responses from Config Store to continue operation
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::D::outgoing.threatDescription: Response blocking: Attacker prevents Controller from receiving responses from Config Store

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::I::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts the response from Config Store to Controller and reads sensitive information
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::I::outgoing.causeDescription: Unencrypted or weakly protected response channel — response data is readable in transit
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::I::outgoing.threatDescription: Eavesdropping on response: Attacker intercepts sensitive response data from Config Store

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::T::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts the response from Config Store and modifies data, causing Controller to process falsified information
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::T::outgoing.causeDescription: Missing integrity protection on the response flow from Config Store — Controller cannot detect modified responses
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-22::T::outgoing.threatDescription: Response tampering: Attacker modifies response data before it reaches Controller

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::I::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts the response from Controller to Update Service and reads sensitive information
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::I::outgoing.causeDescription: Unencrypted or weakly protected response channel — response data is readable in transit
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::I::outgoing.threatDescription: Eavesdropping on response: Attacker intercepts sensitive response data from Controller

df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::T::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts the response from Controller and modifies data, causing Update Service to process falsified information
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::T::outgoing.causeDescription: Missing integrity protection on the response flow from Controller — Update Service cannot detect modified responses
df::Y_GD3hm1UADHv5-dnTFx-24::T::outgoing.threatDescription: Response tampering: Attacker modifies response data before it reaches Update Service
